findings.source_quote: “If there is a book in the Bible that seems to have been written by a cynical man, it is the book of Ecclesiastes.”  (source uses: "the book of Ecclesiastes")
findings.suggested_fix: The translation incorrectly renders the book name and parenthetical labeling. It currently reads: “واعظ یعنی کتابِ اَمثال (Ecclesiastes)”. This is misleading: 'کتابِ امثال' is the Urdu conventional name for Proverbs, not Ecclesiastes. Correct the phrase to use the conventional Urdu name for Ecclesiastes: ‘کتابِ واعظ (Ecclesiastes)’ or simply ‘کتابِ واعظ’ and remove or adjust the parenthetical so it does not create a mismatch. Suggested replacement in that sentence: “اگر بائبل میں کوئی کتاب ہے جو… تو وہ کتابِ واعظ (Ecclesiastes) ہے۔” Keep the surrounding HTML structure unchanged.
